title: The Download: preserving minds and weighing open AI risks
title_en: The Download: preserving minds and weighing open AI risks
author: MIT Tech Review
content_snippet:
As we age, we forget most of what we’ve experienced, yet there’s still undeniable continuity: At 30, or 50, or 70, you will still be you.

To preserve that elusive continuity of self, some far-thinking technologists are exploring ways to keep the brain going, even beyond death. Their ideas range from freezing brains in liquid nitrogen to augmenting living ones and uploading our memories to the cloud.

Here are six possible paths for keeping your mind going, and how feasible they might be.

title: Grok-built apps exposed patient data, plaintext passwords, and SpaceXSI's own sales pipeline
title_en: Grok-built apps exposed patient data, plaintext passwords, and SpaceXSI's own sales pipeline
author: THE DECODER
content_snippet:
Apps built with the AI assistant Grok are almost always open to anyone with the link, according to a security firm. The exposed data includes patient records and confidential documents from Grok maker SpaceXSI itself.

Security firm Claroc found more than 35,000 Grok-built apps that could be accessed without login, according to a recent report. In SpaceXSI's "Build" mode (the company was formerly xAI), users describe an app in a chat and Grok writes the code. An app only goes public when its cre
summary_en: Security researchers discovered over 35,000 apps built via Grok are publicly accessible without authentication. Due to misleading publish settings and predictable URL structures, sensitive data including patient records and internal business pipelines are currently exposed to anyone with a link.
title_zh: Grok开发的AI应用致海量数据泄露
summary_zh: 安全机构发现95%通过Grok生成的应用未设访问权限，导致患者医疗数据及企业内部销售文档被公开

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 安全研究机构调查发现，超过3.5万个由AI助手Grok生成的应用程序在未设防护的情况下公之于众。由于发布界面的默认设置及简单的URL预测机制，包括医疗记录、内部销售机密甚至xAI自身的业务流程均处于裸奔状态。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Security researchers discovered over 35,000 apps built via Grok are publicly accessible without authentication. Due to misleading publish settings and predictable URL structures, sensitive data including patient records and internal business pipelines are currently exposed to anyone with a link.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】AI助手Grok的用户及开发方xAI在Grok.me平台及相关子域名：94.7%的生成应用无需登录即可访问，导致隐私数据泄露
【起因与机理】发布对话框默认预选了“拥有链接者均可访问”且域名规律易被探测
【关键数据与实测】超过94%的Grok生成应用无访问控制。
【各方立场与态度】xAI内部机密文档也在泄露名单中。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Grok users and xAI (Grok.me platform): 94.7% of AI-generated apps are accessible without login, causing massive data leaks
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Default 'anyone with the link' setting and predictable subdomain naming
[Key Metrics] Over 94% of Grok apps lack access control.
[Key Position & Outlook] xAI internal docs are among the leaked files.

title: Enterprise sales push OpenAI's quarterly revenue to $10 billion, though it still trails Anthropic
title_en: Enterprise sales push OpenAI's quarterly revenue to $10 billion, though it still trails Anthropic
author: THE DECODER
content_snippet:
OpenAI posts a massive Q3 revenue jump, driven by new AI models and enterprise customers. But operating losses keep growing, while rival Anthropic operates far more efficiently ahead of its IPO.

According to reports from the Wall Street Journal and The Information, OpenAI grew its revenue by about 50 percent quarter over quarter in Q3 to $10 billion. In Q2, revenue had grown by just 17 to 18 percent. A year earlier, the company brought in $3.9 billion.

Despite tripling revenue within a year, a
summary_en: OpenAI's Q3 revenue surged 50% to $10 billion, fueled by enterprise adoption of new models. Despite this, adjusted operating losses hit $10.9 billion, highlighting a 'growth at all costs' model that lags significantly behind the efficiency of Anthropic.
title_zh: OpenAI营收狂飙百亿，却深陷亏损黑洞
summary_zh: OpenAI三季度营收增至百亿美元，尽管企业级业务激增，但亏损规模进一步扩大，财务效率远逊于竞争对手

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: OpenAI在第三季度营收环比大幅增长50%至100亿美元，这主要得益于企业级客户对新模型的采纳。然而，其调整后运营亏损已升至109亿美元，即便营收连翻三倍，公司依然在“烧钱换增长”的死循环中挣扎，财务表现被盈利能力更强的对手Anthropic全面压制。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: OpenAI's Q3 revenue surged 50% to $10 billion, fueled by enterprise adoption of new models. Despite this, adjusted operating losses hit $10.9 billion, highlighting a 'growth at all costs' model that lags significantly behind the efficiency of Anthropic.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】OpenAI在第三季度财务报告：营收攀升至100亿美元，运营亏损扩大至109亿美元
【起因与机理】模型研发与基础设施投入巨大，对比之下Anthropic已实现盈利
【关键数据与实测】OpenAI在第三季度营收环比大幅增长50%至100亿美元，这主要得益于企业级客户对新模型的采纳。
【各方立场与态度】商业模式效率远不及竞争对手Anthropic。

content_snippet:

summary_en: The UK's Office for Students is mandating a return to traditional exams and oral assessments, warning universities of potential sanctions. author: Reuters

title: MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR teardown: a 5/10 score, a point above the M5 MacBook Pro, and Touch ID works with a new logic board; the backlit logo uses four LEDs (Elizabeth Chamberlain/iFixit News)
title_en: MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR teardown: a 5/10 score, a point above the M5 MacBook Pro, and Touch ID works with a new logic board; the backlit logo uses four LEDs (Elizabeth Chamberlain/iFixit News)
author: iFixit News
content_snippet:
“Fancy new display” makes our screwdrivers nervous, and Apple’s latest MacBook has the fanciest display yet. The MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR is the first-ever touchscreen MacBook. It’s got a tandem OLED panel that hits 120 Hz and peaks at 2,000 nits, powered by your choice of an M5 Pro or M5 Max chip.

And somehow, with a touchscreen and a redesigned hinge, this thing weighs 1.38 kg (three pounds). That’s 170 grams (half a pound) lighter than the M6 14-inch Pro.

“Lighter” also strikes fear in t
summary_en: iFixit performed a teardown of the new MacBook Pro with a PROLED XDR touchscreen, awarding it a 5/10 repairability score. While Apple resolved the Touch ID logic board calibration issue, essential components like fans and USB-C ports remain buried under the logic board, significantly complicating repairs.

Within the core, a redesigned vector engine pushes AMD’s SIMD performance even higher, and it now natively supports half-precision FP16 instructions alongside full, 32-bit precision. It also splits integer schedulers within the execution engine, allowing for more instructions in flight through the core.
